signals.summary: Reco provides a SaaS and AI security platform covering application discovery, posture management, identity governance, threat detection, data exposure, and AI agent security.
signals.evidence: Reco combines SaaS discovery, posture management, identity governance, threat detection, data exposure, and AI agent security.

signals.summary: Reco features a no-code and low-code integration engine called Reco Factory supporting more than 260 applications.
signals.evidence: One of Reco’s clearest differentiators is its no-code and low-code integration engine, previously called the SaaS App Factory and now presented as Reco Factory. The company states that it supports more than 260 applications
